question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f28e55dd0b49d1fd6354bd518a22e164faf0d5da51b3b1a58d14b1464be4befe.png] 

For which of the following years was the percentage rise/fall in production from the previous year maximum for country R?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f28e55dd0b49d1fd6354bd518a22e164faf0d5da51b3b1a58d14b1464be4befe.png] 

**Concept Used:**

Percentage Increase = (Increase ÷ Original Quantity) × 100

**Calculation:**

Production in the year 2011 = 40 lakh tonnes

Production in the year 2012 = 30 lakh tonnes

Difference between 2011 and 2012 as production fall = 40 – 30 = 10 lakh tonnes

Production in the year 2013 = 50 lakh tonnes

Difference between 2012 and 2013 as production rise = 50 – 30 = 20 lakh tonnes

Production in the year 2014 = 20 lakh tonnes

Difference between 2013 and 2014 as production fall = 50 – 20 = 30 lakh tonnes

Production in the year 2015 = 50 lakh tonnes

Difference between 2014 and 2015 as production rise = 50 – 20 = 30 lakh tonnes.

Percentage production rose in 2015 = (3000000)/(2000000)times 100=150% %

**∴ The percentage production rise/fall from the previous year for country R is maximum in 2015**
